nodes.label: John Maeda Laws of Simplicity Application
nodes.rationale: Applies Maeda's 10 Laws of Simplicity to Reasoner project. Uses DFWS (Design for Web Simplicity) protocol with DFM (Design for Manufacturability), DFA (Design for Assembly), and Digital Poka-Yoke. Maps each law to concrete UI/UX and architecture decisions including progressive disclosure, SSE streaming, and phase timeline exposure.
